task_commit_basis: merge commit of the reference change (code after the optimization landed), from https://github.com/google/gson/commit/115bcc7e1136f50eb89c9f7ae579e340fd27d117

reference_change.title: Avoid quadratic removeIf in JsonArray list views

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/google/gson/pull/3115: removing two thirds of a 20,000 element JsonArray through asList().removeIf, in process, warmed up until stable (eval/tasks/workloads/google-gson-pr3115-landed/RemoveIfWorkload.java)

oracle.source: JsonArrayAsListTest, the test class https://github.com/google/gson/pull/3115 extends; targeted tests only

evidence.note: after-landed: NonNullElementWrapperList.removeIf delegates to ArrayList.removeIf instead of the quadratic iterator removal. The task tree is the merge

status_reason: built here, and the oracle ran on the task and reference trees (see runs); the workload was run too, but only in an earlier form (below). The repository has no Maven wrapper and this Mac has no Maven, so it is built where Maven is installed (the Linux box eval/tasks/workloads/java/Dockerfile: Temurin 21 and apt's Maven. The workload runs recorded here predate the warm-up rule now in the committed workload (a floor of 200 iterations, 1% tolerance, a cap of 600 that reports instead of failing); the iteration bodies are unchanged, but the program that ran is not the committed one, so workload.verified is false until it is run again on a quiet machine.
